能源转型为什么必须讲"公正"（just transition）？

Why must the energy transition be "just"?

转型会淘汰煤矿、油田相关岗位，若只谈减碳不顾劳动者生计，会制造新的不公；公正转型要求配套再培训、新产业和社保，让没人被落下。
The shift ends coal and oil jobs; if we cut carbon but ignore workers' livelihoods, we create new injustice. A just transition adds retraining, new industries and social support so no one is left behind.

煤矿城市的工人，为什么需要"换个赛道"的帮助？

Why do coal-town workers need help "switching tracks"?

他们的技能高度绑定煤炭，矿井关闭后很难直接转行；需要政府与企业提供培训、产业和公共服务，否则整座城市会陷入"矿停人困"。
Their skills are tied to coal, so a mine closure leaves few direct options; governments and firms must offer training, industries and services, or whole cities stall.

全球气候行动，为什么要把发展中国家放在"不同起跑线"？

Why must global climate action put developing countries on a "different starting line"?

发达国家历史上排得多、如今财力技术强，发展中国家还要兼顾脱贫；"共同但有区别的责任"就是承认这种不公平的历史与能力差异。
Developed nations emitted more historically and have more wealth and tech, while developing ones still fight poverty; "common but differentiated responsibilities" acknowledges that unfair history and capacity gap.
